messages:
sam: Kickoff 1: Federal agency wants an air-gapped POC. Requirements: physical media delivery, FIPS signing, offline activation, monthly security patches only, feature updates every 6 months. Can we scope packaging + a rough commercial for the offline add-on?

tay: I can take technical presales. Quick clarifiers: acceptable media types (SSD, USB, DVD)? shipping constraints? Do they require chain-of-custody documentation?

nora: They prefer encrypted SSDs (preferred) or multiple signed USBs. They want an auditable chain-of-custody log for each handoff.

eli: Ops reality: we recommend shipping encrypted NVMe image + signed provenance tarball. For sizes: if any single file >30GB we need multi-part archives and resumeable transfer logic.

eli: Sample part manifest we embed in bundle:

```
parts:
 - id: part-0001
   size: 21474836480
   sha256: abcdef...
 - id: part-0002
   size: 21474836480
   sha256: 123456...
signed_by: redwood-release
provenance: signed-provenance.tar.gz
```

sam: Security asks from their questionnaire: offline key custody options, escrow vs customer-only keys, requirement for reproducible builds, and FIPS/HSM compatibility.

tay: We support two modes: vendor-signed (we hold signing keys in HSM) or customer-supplied keypair (we sign with customer key offline). Both support FIPS algorithms. If they want escrow, note procurement lead time.

eli: Activation flow options: 1) CSR-based token: customer generates CSR -> we produce signed activation token -> customer imports. 2) Signed license file bound to HW fingerprint. Both work offline.

nora: For quantized model delivery: we can produce int8/GPTQ artifacts. If we produce them, we provide a signed SBOM and build log. Customer prefers reproducible logs, so we'll include deterministic build flags.

tay: Caveat: generating quantized deltas can require full image rebuilds. Typical delta generation window: 24-96h depending on model size and whether we need to retrain conversion tests. Call that out in SOW.

sam: Commercial: buyer asked for a ballpark offline engineering fee + signing service + one week of on-site validation. Any ballpark?

nora: Ballpark: offline packaging & signing service $25k$60k (range depends on number of model artifacts and HSM complexity). On-site validation daily rate separate. Include clause: final estimate after BOM review.

eli: Acceptance checklist proposal we can include in SOW: 
- signed bundle validates with offline CA
- SBOM and signed provenance delivered
- installer performs without external DNS or NTP
- chunked install resumes on failure
- cert rotation tested in staging with no internet
- rollback tested to previous signed bundle within 4 hours

contracts-bot: Note: include export control review for quantized weights and add compliance clause.

tay: Ops question: what's our hard threshold for single-file size where we require multi-disk shipping? We usually flag >30GB as needing multi-disk, >80GB requires special handling.

eli: Confirmed: >30GB single artifact -> multi-part; >80GB -> recommend NVMe shipment or S3-Transfer via approved courier. Also we can compress but some formats (MMAP) are not compressible.

sam: Action items: 1) I will request BOM + whether GPUs provided (ETA: EOD). 2) @tay to confirm quantization acceptance with ML lead. 3) @eli to validate part-resume limits on staging and run a chunked install test by Thursday. 4) @nora to draft SOW addendum with pricing band and acceptance checklist.

sre-bot: deploy-bot: staging airgap rig maintenance scheduled 2026-03-28 01:00-03:00 UTC - good window for chunked install tests.

nora: Noted. I'll add HSM procurement lead time (6+ weeks) as a dependency in the addendum.

tay: Small follow-up: customer asked about certificate escrow. Recommend we present three options: customer-only keys, vendor-managed HSM with escrow, or third-party escrow. Each has different cost/risk.

sam: Good. I'll consolidate options in the response to the buyer and attach preliminary SOW. Thanks all.
